summary: Verified all 4 one-click demo login buttons on the web panel /login page. Admin, Partner, Customer, and Merchant demo logins all succeed via OTP-based flow (dev OTP 123456) and land on their respective dashboards. No 'Demo login failed', CORS, or network errors observed on the UI. Backend URL resolution (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty -> window.location.origin + /api) works correctly through the external preview URL.

minor.issue: Returns 403 when hit under a Customer-role session on /account. Appears a partner-scoped polling/prefetch call is firing for non-partner roles. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

integration_issues.issue: After landing on /account as Customer, 2x GET /api/partner/alert-prefs return 403 (visible in console as 'Failed to load resource: 403'). Customer session should not be issuing partner-scoped calls.

action_items: (Low priority) Guard the partner alert-prefs prefetch so it only runs when the authenticated role is 'partner'. Currently fires under Customer session and returns 403.
critical_code_review_comments: Demo login flow works end-to-end for all 4 roles via the external preview URL — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty + window.location.origin + /api fallback is functioning correctly through Kubernetes ingress.
Partner alert-prefs hook appears to run globally instead of being role-gated (see 403s on Customer session).
test_credentials: Demo OTP 123456. Admin +919000000000, Merchant +919000000002, Partner +919000000003, Customer +919000000004. One-click buttons on /login used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing (/) page does NOT contain the demo login buttons; they are on /login. Note that get_by_text('Partner') on the home page will match the 'Become a Partner' nav link — use exact button name 'Login as {Role}' or a data-testid. After Admin login, do not use wait_until='networkidle' because the admin dashboard has continuous polling — use 'domcontentloaded' and clear cookies/localStorage between role tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no demo login failures. Only observation: 403 on /api/partner/alert-prefs under Customer role indicates missing role-guard on the client-side hook triggering that call.
